scope: Current Android app screens and the resizable home-screen widget, captured on an emulator for the Google Play listing.
captureMethod: adb exec-out screencap -p of the installed universal APK; original PNGs unchanged. SystemUI demo mode fixed the status bar (9:41, full battery, Wi-Fi, no notification icons). Wallpaper set to a plain #D7D7D1 image so widget edges are measurable. The reading, timeline and widget content is the live production reading at capture time.
limits: Emulator evidence, not a physical Android device.
Live content: the sentences are production readings from 2026-10-15 and will not match later readings.
The timeline was scrolled one entry so its first visible entry is not the newest; the newest entry named an AI company, and the listing never mentions AI.
Expanded layout needs a minimum height of 150dp; on this launcher 4x2 still reported compact and 4x3 showed the sentence.
Another local session installed and launched an unrelated app (com.spaceworms.app) on this emulator during the widget captures; it is not in any capture.
Large text, score 10 and notification delivery were not part of this capture.

captures.description: Reading after skipping the introduction on first launch; app appearance Follow device, device light.
Timeline below the reading (chevron), scrolled one entry so the list starts at the 18h entry; light.
Same timeline position after the device switched to dark; app follows the device.
Reading after tapping the wordmark, device dark.
Settings sheet from the gear: Appearance Follow device, Notifications Off, Show timeline on, Last checked, Privacy, Support, Introduction.
Settings > Notifications: High-score alerts off, Threshold 8 or higher.
RatingWidgetConfigure opened from the second widget: Show app name on, Appearance Follow device.
Home screen, one widget at its default 2x2, Follow device (light), neutral wallpaper.
Two 2x2 widgets: left Follow device (light), right set to Dark in its own settings.
Left widget removed; the Dark widget resized to 4 columns x 3 rows; expanded layout with the sentence and age prefix.
The same 4x3 widget set to Light in its own settings.
